column1: # 2026-08-04. Golden Seeds and Sacred Tears -- the whole population (43 seeds, 13 tears over 56
# flags) hand-described by Alaric in one pass, from the in-game locations. Every one of these was
# previously rendered by the auto-descriptor waterfall: 43 by nearest-grace, 9 by tile-grace, 1 by
# machine locale, and f400220 by nothing at all. 10 of them ALSO had their region confirmed in the
# same pass -- see _REGION_CONFIRMED_FLAGS in gen_data.py, same commit.
# Two flags in that pass got a note rather than a description and are deliberately absent here:
#   f12057010 (Mohgwyn seed)   -- "bar this from progression, this one's complicated" -> now in
#                                 _SURFACE_EXCLUDE_FLAGS. Its auto descriptor is left alone.
#   f39207170 (Liurnia tear)   -- "seemingly not a real check". It was ALREADY excluded on
#                                 suspicion 2026-07-31; this is a second independent in-game
#                                 report that it is not where we say it is. Still not a location
#                                 claim we can write down, so it keeps its hedged auto name.
# f400220 (Roundtable Hold seed) is untouched -- it was left blank in the pass.
# 🛑 THREE of his 53 rows are NOT here, and were dropped deliberately: f1041387100 "near Stormhill
# Shack", f1049557800 "near Consecrated Snowfield", f14007990 "near Schoolhouse Classroom". Each
# reproduced the nearest-grace layer BYTE FOR BYTE -- measured, by regenerating with them in and
# diffing data.py: 48 of the 51 names moved, those 3 did not. A layer-1 entry that only repeats
# layer 4 is the redundant override CONTRIBUTING forbids: it cannot be told apart from a
# load-bearing one, so nobody dares delete it and the crutch calcifies. The derivation already
# reaches these three; if the grace join ever drifts, that is a bug to fix there, not to pin here.
